title: Clasify
shortDescription: Classify supplied state or locate answers in unread resources without returning bodies.
description: For explicit classification, or locating behavior (no literal) in ≥2 files; not identifiers/literals/PR filters. Scout: unread context:{tool,query}; lists: per-item pages + next.read; read relevant, insufficient items. locate (source windows) needs unminified localFetch/ghGetFileContent or fileChunks. Read best (else page matches) at exists ≥0.5, else next.clasify; use source.path/scope, not view offsets. Expand missing deciding evidence. Judge: context:{value}. One atomic fact/question; batch same-evidence questions. Hints only; verify source before claims. Partial/error stays unresolved.

inputSchema.description: One matrix or independent matrices; omitted IDs are derived by position.

reasoning.description: Sent in the evidence state: what the next read depends on.

goal.description: Sent with every question and in the evidence state.

maxChars.description: Capture cap; oversize errors. Continue with next.clasify.

prefilter.description: File reads only: rare literals pick the 3 densest 600-line windows. Common words still cover the file. No hits uses the original read.

resources.description: Independent captures, each reused for all questions. Supplied IDs must be unique.

questions.description: Atomic facts applied to every page; ≤25 cells. Split wrong cross-products.

carry.description: Running ranking from next.clasify, including windows withheld from best. Copy unchanged.

tool.description: Unread tool query; returns judgments, not its body.

path.description: Absolute local or repo-relative GitHub path.

query.description: One direct read query, never queries[]; inspect that tool's schema.

candidateEvidence.description: Search only: snippets, or ≤5 files × ≤12000 chars; fileChunks enables locate.

QuerySemanticContextOf1.description: State or a read-only tool query; the judge sees tool+query.

questionType.description: contribution/supportsClaim screen evidence; sufficient: answer stated, no read needed; locate ranks source windows (unminified read or fileChunks).

false.description: What counts as no; null is allowed.
